    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Python GUI自动化神器PyAutoGUI</span>

		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="bodyCustomClass">
<div class="bodyCustomClass">
<blockquote>
<p>PyAutoGUI 是 Python 的自动化控制库，可模拟鼠标、键盘操作，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux，安装前需确保已安装 Python（推荐 3.6+）和 pip。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="_nav_0" class="blogCustomTitleStyle"><span class="blogCustomTitleIco">v</span>基础功能</h2>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">一、PyAutoGUI 安装</h3>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">PyAutoGUI 是 Python 的自动化控制库，可模拟鼠标、键盘操作，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux，安装前需确保已安装 Python（推荐 3.6+）和 pip。</div>
<h4 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">1. 基础安装（通用）</h4>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">打开命令行（CMD/Terminal），执行：</div>
<div class="container-Uxvbjy md-box-line-break wrapper-GYqxgQ undefined">&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 基础安装（Windows/macOS/Linux 通用）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">pip install pyautogui

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 若系统有多个Python版本，用pip3</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">pip3 install pyautogui

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 国内源加速（推荐）</span>
pip install pyautogui -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple</pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">2. 不同系统的额外依赖</h4>
<ul class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>Windows：无需额外依赖，安装后直接使用。</li>
<li>macOS：需安装 PyObjC（系统交互依赖），执行：
<div class="container-Uxvbjy md-box-line-break wrapper-GYqxgQ undefined">&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 先装核心依赖，再装完整PyObjC</span>
pip3 install pyobjc-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">core
pip3 install pyobjc</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
此外，macOS 需给终端 / IDE 开启「辅助功能」权限（系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能），否则无法模拟操作。</li>
<li>Linux：需安装截图和 X11 依赖，以 Debian/Ubuntu 为例：
<div class="code-block-element-R6c8c0 light custom-code-block-container--bash hide-indicator disable-theme-style custom-code-block-container">
<div class="code-area-yxsM36 code-area" dir="ltr">
<div class="mask-wrapper-ujeSdZ">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sudo apt-get install scrot python3-xlib</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">二、PyAutoGUI 核心使用</h3>
<h4 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">1. 基础配置（必做）</h4>
<div class="code-block-element-R6c8c0 light custom-code-block-container--python hide-indicator disable-theme-style custom-code-block-container">
<div class="code-area-yxsM36 code-area" dir="ltr">
<div class="header-wrapper-Mbk8s6">
<div class="header-IAeXdE">
<div class="title-TXcgFG clickable-cKrA4B" data-popupid="hmbaxjz">
<div class="text-OkYU_0">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pyautogui

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 安全设置：鼠标移到屏幕左上角（0,0）触发异常，终止程序（防止失控）</span>
pyautogui.FAILSAFE =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 每次操作后暂停1秒（防止操作过快，便于调试）</span>
pyautogui.PAUSE = 1</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h4 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">2. 屏幕相关操作</h4>
<h5 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">（1）获取屏幕尺寸</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取屏幕宽高（返回元组：(宽度, 高度)）</span>
screen_width, screen_height =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pyautogui.size()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">屏幕尺寸：{screen_width}x{screen_height}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h5 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">（2）截图操作</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 截取整个屏幕，返回PIL图像对象</span>
screenshot =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pyautogui.screenshot()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存截图到本地</span>
screenshot.save(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">full_screen.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 截取指定区域（x,y 起始坐标，width,height 宽高）</span>
region_screenshot = pyautogui.screenshot(region=(100, 100, 300, 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
region_screenshot.save(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">region_screen.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h4 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">3. 鼠标操作</h4>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">PyAutoGUI 的坐标系统：屏幕左上角为 (0, 0)，向右 x 递增，向下 y 递增。</div>
<h5 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">（1）移动鼠标</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绝对移动：移到屏幕(500, 500)位置，耗时2秒（平滑移动）</span>
pyautogui.moveTo(500, 500, duration=2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 相对移动：从当前位置向右移100像素，向下移50像素，耗时1秒</span>
pyautogui.moveRel(100, 50, duration=1)</pre>
</div>
<h5 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">（2）点击鼠标</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 左键单击（默认）：在(500, 500)位置点击</span>
pyautogui.click(500, 500<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 右键单击</span>
pyautogui.rightClick(500, 500<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 双击左键</span>
pyautogui.doubleClick(500, 500<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 左键按住再释放（拖拽基础）</span>
pyautogui.mouseDown(500, 500)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按住</span>
pyautogui.mouseUp(800, 800)    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 释放（移到800,800）</span></pre>
</div>
<h5 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">（3）拖拽鼠标</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从(100,100)拖拽到(400,400)，耗时2秒</span>
pyautogui.dragTo(400, 400, duration=2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 相对拖拽：从当前位置向右拖200像素，向上拖100像素</span>
pyautogui.dragRel(200, -100, duration=1)</pre>
</div>
<h5 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">（4）滚动鼠标</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 滚动鼠标滚轮（正数向上，负数向下），在(500,500)位置滚动</span>
pyautogui.scroll(10, x=500, y=500)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 向上滚10格</span>
pyautogui.scroll(-10, x=500, y=500) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 向下滚10格</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">4. 键盘操作</h4>
<h5 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">（1）输入文字</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直接输入文字（支持英文，中文需确保输入法匹配）</span>
pyautogui.typewrite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello PyAutoGUI!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 逐字符输入，间隔0.2秒（模拟人工输入）</span>
pyautogui.typewrite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello World</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, interval=0.2)</pre>
</div>
<h5 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">（2）单键操作</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按下并释放单个按键（如回车、空格）</span>
pyautogui.press(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">enter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按回车键</span>
pyautogui.press(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">space</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按空格键</span>
pyautogui.press(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">esc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按ESC键</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按住按键 → 释放按键（组合键基础）</span>
pyautogui.keyDown(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shift</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按住shift</span>
pyautogui.keyUp(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shift</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 释放shift</span></pre>
</div>
<h5 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">（3）组合键操作</h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 快捷键：Ctrl+C（复制）</span>
pyautogui.hotkey(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ctrl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">c</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 快捷键：Ctrl+V（粘贴）</span>
pyautogui.hotkey(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ctrl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">v</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 快捷键：Alt+F4（关闭窗口，Windows）</span>
pyautogui.hotkey(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">alt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f4</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h4 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">5. 图像定位（精准操作）</h4>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">通过截图匹配屏幕上的目标位置，返回坐标：</div>
<div class="container-Uxvbjy md-box-line-break wrapper-GYqxgQ undefined">&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定位屏幕上的目标图片（需提前保存目标截图，如button.png）</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回值：(x, y, 宽度, 高度)，若未找到返回None</span>
target_pos = pyautogui.locateOnScreen(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> target_pos:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取目标图片的中心坐标</span>
    center_x, center_y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pyautogui.center(target_pos)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 点击目标中心</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    pyautogui.click(center_x, center_y)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找到目标图片</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可选参数：提高匹配容错率（grayscale=True 灰度匹配，confidence=0.8 置信度）</span>
target_pos = pyautogui.locateOnScreen(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, grayscale=True, confidence=0.8)</pre>
</div>
</div>
<blockquote class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-pP9ZLC paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">注意：图像定位需确保截图与屏幕显示一致（分辨率、缩放比例），否则匹配失败。</div>
</blockquote>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">三、完整示例：自动打开记事本并输入文字</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pyautogui
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 基础配置</span>
pyautogui.FAILSAFE =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True
pyautogui.PAUSE </span>= 1

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 打开Windows开始菜单（按Win键）</span>
pyautogui.press(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">win</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 输入“记事本”并回车</span>
pyautogui.typewrite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">记事本</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
pyautogui.press(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">enter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 等待记事本打开（额外延时，确保窗口加载）</span>
time.sleep(2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 在记事本中输入文字</span>
pyautogui.typewrite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello PyAutoGUI！\n这是自动化输入的内容～</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, interval=0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 保存文件（Ctrl+S）</span>
pyautogui.hotkey(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ctrl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 输入文件名并保存</span>
pyautogui.typewrite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">自动化测试.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
pyautogui.press(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">enter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">四、注意事项</h3>
<ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>防止失控：开启&nbsp;<code>FAILSAFE = True</code>，操作失控时快速将鼠标移到屏幕左上角终止程序。</li>
<li>权限问题：macOS/Linux 需开启对应权限，否则无法模拟操作。</li>
<li>中文输入：PyAutoGUI 直接&nbsp;<code>typewrite</code>&nbsp;中文可能乱码，建议先切换到中文输入法，或使用剪贴板 + 粘贴（<code>pyperclip</code>&nbsp;库配合&nbsp;<code>hotkey("ctrl","v")</code>）。</li>
<li>调试技巧：先通过&nbsp;<code>pyautogui.position()</code>&nbsp;打印当前鼠标坐标，确定目标位置后再写代码。</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">五、常见问题</h3>
<ul class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>安装失败：升级 pip（<code>pip install --upgrade pip</code>），或检查 Python 环境是否正常。</li>
<li>操作无响应：检查系统权限（macOS/Linux）、坐标是否正确、目标窗口是否在前台。</li>
<li>图像定位失败：确保截图清晰、分辨率匹配，添加&nbsp;<code>confidence</code>&nbsp;参数降低匹配精度。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="_nav_0" class="blogCustomTitleStyle"><span class="blogCustomTitleIco">v</span>auto input</h2>
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 21px; color: rgba(75, 211, 211, 1); text-decoration: underline">初级</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pyautogui

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 您的代码内容，用三引号字符串保存</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 确保有足够的时间将光标切换到您指定的文件或输入框</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 解决搜狗输入法自动切换中文的问题 ==========</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">正在切换到英文输入法...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
pyautogui.hotkey(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ctrl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">space</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 切换到英文输入法</span>
time.sleep(0.5)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 等待切换完成</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ===================================================</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">开始输入代码...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化变量</span>
line_count = 0  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 行计数器</span>
threshold = random.randint(5, 30)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 随机阈值，5-30行之间</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">当前阈值：每 {threshold} 行后切换延迟范围</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 逐行逐字符输入</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> line <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> code_to_type.splitlines():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 为当前行的每个字符生成随机延迟</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> char <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> line:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 为每个字符生成0.1到2.0秒之间的随机延迟</span>
        delay_between_chars = random.uniform(0.1, 2.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        pyautogui.write(char, interval</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">delay_between_chars)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 行计数器加1</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查是否达到阈值</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> line_count &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> threshold:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 达到阈值，使用长延迟范围：6.0-20.0秒</span>
        delay_between_lines = random.uniform(6.0, 20.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">第 {line_count} 行：达到阈值，使用长延迟范围 (6.0-20.0秒)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重置计数器和生成新的随机阈值</span>
        line_count =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
        threshold </span>= random.randint(5, 30<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">重置阈值：每 {threshold} 行后切换延迟范围</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 未达到阈值，使用正常延迟范围：1.5-5.0秒</span>
        delay_between_lines = random.uniform(1.5, 5.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">第 {line_count} 行：正常延迟范围 (1.5-5.0秒)，距离阈值还有 {threshold - line_count} 行</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    time.sleep(delay_between_lines)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">代码输入完成！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>

        self.error_detection_delay_max = 3.0  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最大检测延迟</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当前状态</span>
        self.current_gaze_target = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当前注视目标：code/keyboard</span>
        self.last_gaze_switch =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
        self.pending_errors </span>= []           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 待检测的错误</span>
        
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> simulate_gaze_switch(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模拟视觉注意力切换</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> random.random() &lt; 0.1:  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 10%概率切换注视目标</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> self.current_gaze_target == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                self.current_gaze_target </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">keyboard</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟看键盘的时间</span>
                gaze_time = random.uniform(0.1, 0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                time.sleep(gaze_time)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  👀 视线切换到键盘 ({gaze_time:.1f}s)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                self.current_gaze_target </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟看代码的时间</span>
                gaze_time = random.uniform(0.2, 1.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                time.sleep(gaze_time)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  👀 视线切换到代码 ({gaze_time:.1f}s)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            
            self.last_gaze_switch </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> False
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> schedule_error_detection(self, error_info):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">安排错误检测（人类不会立即发现错误）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        detection_delay </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> random.uniform(
            self.error_detection_delay_min,
            self.error_detection_delay_max
        )
        error_info[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">detection_time</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = time.time() +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detection_delay
        self.pending_errors.append(error_info)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> check_pending_errors(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">检查是否有错误需要检测</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        current_time </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
        errors_to_detect </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> error <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.pending_errors[:]:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> current_time &gt;= error[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">detection_time</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]:
                errors_to_detect.append(error)
                self.pending_errors.remove(error)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> errors_to_detect

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update_fatigue(self, elapsed_time):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">更新疲劳程度</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 随时间增加疲劳</span>
        self.fatigue_level = min(1.0, elapsed_time / 3600)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1小时后达到最大疲劳</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 疲劳影响参数</span>
        fatigue_factor = 1.0 + self.fatigue_level * 0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        self.effective_speed </span>= self.base_speed /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fatigue_factor
        self.effective_error_rate </span>= self.error_rate *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fatigue_factor
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update_learning(self, lines_typed):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">更新学习曲线</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 每输入100行，学习曲线增加0.1</span>
        self.learning_curve = min(1.0, lines_typed / 1000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 学习影响参数</span>
        learning_factor = 1.0 - self.learning_curve * 0.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        self.effective_error_rate </span>= self.error_rate *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> learning_factor

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 上下文感知引擎 ==========</span>

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 常见模式库</span>

            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">html</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;div&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;/div&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;span&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;/span&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">class="</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id="</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],

            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cpp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#include</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">using namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cout &lt;&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cin &gt;&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detect_language(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">检测代码语言</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        code_sample </span>= code_to_type[:500<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].lower()
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;template&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> code_sample <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;div&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> code_sample:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">html</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">import </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> code_sample <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">from </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> code_sample <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">as </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> code_sample):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">function </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> code_sample <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">const </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> code_sample <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">let </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> code_sample:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">javascript</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">public </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> code_sample <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">class </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> code_sample <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">void </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> code_sample:

        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#include</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> code_sample <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">namespace </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> code_sample:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cpp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">unknown</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyze_line(self, line):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">分析代码行上下文</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        line_stripped </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> line.strip()
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新括号平衡</span>
        self.brace_balance += line.count(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) - line.count(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        self.parenthesis_balance </span>+= line.count(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) - line.count(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检测上下文变化</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> line_stripped.endswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
            self.context_stack.append(self.current_context)
            self.current_context </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">block</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            self.indent_level </span>+= 1
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> line_stripped.startswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> line_stripped == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.context_stack:
                self.current_context </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.context_stack.pop()
            self.indent_level </span>= max(0, self.indent_level - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检测特定结构</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> any(pattern <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> line <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> pattern <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.common_patterns.get(self.code_language, [])):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pattern</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> line <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> line <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> line:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">comment</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> line_stripped:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">empty</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> len(line_stripped) &lt; 20<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">simple</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">complex</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_context_suggestion(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">根据上下文提供建议</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> self.code_language == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">html</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> self.current_context == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">block</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">考虑闭合标签</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> self.brace_balance &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">需要 {self.brace_balance} 个右大括号</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> self.parenthesis_balance &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">需要 {self.parenthesis_balance} 个右括号</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 真实错误模式库 ==========</span>

        self.syntax_errors =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
            (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span>),      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 缺少分号</span>
            (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>),     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 括号不匹配</span>
            (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>),     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 大括号不匹配</span>
            (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>),     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 方括号不匹配</span>
            (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">==</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>),    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 赋值 vs 比较</span>
            (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">==</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>),    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 比较 vs 赋值</span>
            (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&amp;&amp;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&amp;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>),    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 逻辑与 vs 位与</span>
            (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">||</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">|</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>),    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 逻辑或 vs 位或</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ]
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 习惯性错误（个人特有）</span>
        self.habitual_errors =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 经常忘记大写 I</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ]
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> generate_realistic_error(self, word, context):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">生成真实的错误</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> word.lower() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.common_typos:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> random.random() &lt; 0.3:  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 30%概率犯常见错误</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> random.choice(self.common_typos[word.lower()])
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 大小写错误</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> word <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> word[0].isalpha():
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> random.random() &lt; 0.1:  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 10%概率大小写错误</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> word[0].islower():
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> word[0].upper() + word[1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:]
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> word[0].lower() + word[1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:]
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 顺序错误（交换相邻字符）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> len(word) &gt; 2 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> random.random() &lt; 0.05<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            idx </span>= random.randint(0, len(word) - 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            chars </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list(word)
            chars[idx], chars[idx </span>+ 1] = chars[idx + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">], chars[idx]
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.join(chars)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 动态参数管理器（增强版） ==========</span>

        self.mood_state = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">neutral</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 情绪状态</span>

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> apply_mood_effects(self):

            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">confident</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ERROR_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 0.7, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SPEED_CHANGE_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1.2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
