            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> param, factor <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mood_effects[self.mood_state].items():
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> param <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.current_params:
                    self.current_params[param] </span>*=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factor
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update_mood(self, recent_errors, recent_speed):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">根据近期表现更新情绪</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> recent_errors &gt; 3:  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 错误太多</span>
            self.mood_state = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">frustrated</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> recent_speed &gt; self.personality.base_speed * 1.2:  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 速度很快</span>
            self.mood_state = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">confident</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> recent_speed &lt; self.personality.base_speed * 0.7:  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 速度很慢</span>
            self.mood_state = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tired</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            self.mood_state </span>= random.choice([<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">neutral</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">focused</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rushed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
        
        self.apply_mood_effects()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  😊 情绪状态: {self.mood_state}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update_params(self, line_num, context_analysis):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">更新参数（每行调用）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        self.switch_countdown </span>-= 1
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定期随机切换</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> self.switch_countdown &lt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            self.random_switch_all_params()
            self.switch_countdown </span>= random.randint(8, 15<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  🔄 参数随机切换 (下次: {self.switch_countdown}行后)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 上下文调整</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> random.random() &lt; self.current_params[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CONTEXT_AWARE_ADJUSTMENT_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]:
            self.adjust_for_context(context_analysis)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> random_switch_all_params(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">随机切换所有参数</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        old_params </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.current_params.copy()
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> key <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.current_params.keys():
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 随机变化 ±30%</span>
            change = random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            new_value </span>= self.current_params[key] * (1 +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> change)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保持在合理范围</span>
            self.current_params[key] = max(0.01, min(0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, new_value))
        
        self.param_history.append({
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">timestamp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: datetime.now().isoformat(),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">old</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: old_params,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: self.current_params.copy()
        })
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> adjust_for_context(self, context):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">根据上下文调整参数</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        context_adjustments </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">complex</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">THINKING_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1.5, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ERROR_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">simple</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">THINKING_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 0.7, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ERROR_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 0.8<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pattern</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AUTOCOMPLETE_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1.4, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ERROR_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 0.6<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">comment</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">THINKING_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 0.5, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SPEED_CHANGE_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1.2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">empty</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SPEED_CHANGE_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 1.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
        }
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> context <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context_adjustments:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> param, factor <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context_adjustments[context].items():
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> param <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.current_params:
                    self.current_params[param] </span>*=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factor

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 主程序 ==========</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 70<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🤖 超真实人类代码输入模拟器 v3.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 70<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 选择程序员类型</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n👤 选择程序员类型:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, ptype <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> enumerate(ProgrammerType, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  {i}. {ptype.value}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        choice </span>= int(input(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请输入编号 (1-6, 默认2): </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        programmer_type </span>= list(ProgrammerType)[choice - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        programmer_type </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProgrammerType.INTERMEDIATE
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n🎭 模拟: {programmer_type.value} 程序员</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化所有组件</span>
    lines =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> code_to_type.splitlines()
    total_lines </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> len(lines)
    
    personality </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PersonalityProfile(programmer_type)
    context_engine </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ContextAwareEngine()
    error_library </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RealisticErrorLibrary()
    param_manager </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EnhancedDynamicParamManager(personality)
    cognitive_model </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CognitiveModelSimulator()
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📝 检测到代码语言: {context_engine.code_language}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📊 总行数: {total_lines}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⏳ 准备开始输入 (5秒后开始)...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 切换到英文输入法</span>
    pyautogui.hotkey(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ctrl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">space</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n🚀 开始模拟人类代码输入...\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 统计变量</span>
    start_time =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
    total_errors </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
    recent_error_count </span>= []  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 修复：改为列表存储每行的错误数</span>
    recent_speed_samples =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
    line_timings </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主输入循环</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> line_index, line <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enumerate(lines):
        line_num </span>= line_index + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        line_start_time </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 显示进度</span>
        progress = (line_num / total_lines) * 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        elapsed </span>= time.time() -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> start_time
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> line_num &gt; 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            avg_time_per_line </span>= elapsed / (line_num - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            eta </span>= (total_lines - line_num) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> avg_time_per_line
            eta_str </span>= f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{eta/60:.1f}分钟</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            eta_str </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算中...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[{line_num:3d}/{total_lines}] 进度: {progress:5.1f}% | ETA: {eta_str}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  代码: {line[:50]}...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> len(line) &gt; 50 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  代码: {line}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 更新个性化状态</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        personality.update_fatigue(elapsed)
        personality.update_learning(line_num)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 分析上下文</span>
        context =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context_engine.analyze_line(line)
        context_suggestion </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context_engine.get_context_suggestion()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context_suggestion:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  💡 上下文提示: {context_suggestion}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 更新参数和情绪</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        param_manager.update_params(line_num, context)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> line_num % 5 == 0:  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 每5行更新一次情绪</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 修复：计算最近错误总数</span>
            recent_errors_total = sum(recent_error_count[-5:]) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> recent_error_count <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
            recent_speed_avg </span>= sum(recent_speed_samples[-5:])/5 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> recent_speed_samples <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> personality.base_speed
            param_manager.update_mood(recent_errors_total, recent_speed_avg)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 模拟认知过程</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        cognitive_model.simulate_gaze_switch()
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 检查待检测的错误</span>
        pending_errors =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cognitive_model.check_pending_errors()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> error <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pending_errors:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  🔍 检测到错误: {error['type']} -&gt; {error['original']}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟纠正错误</span>
            time.sleep(random.uniform(0.3, 1.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> _ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(len(error[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">original</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])):
                pyautogui.press(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">backspace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                time.sleep(</span>0.05<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            pyautogui.write(error[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">corrected</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>], interval=0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            total_errors </span>+= 1
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 逐词输入（更真实）</span>
        words = line.split(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        line_errors </span>= 0  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 本行错误计数</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> word_index, word <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enumerate(words):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 词间空格（除了最后一个词）</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> word_index &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
                pyautogui.write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, interval=random.uniform(0.05, 0.2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查是否应该犯错误</span>
            should_error = random.random() &lt; param_manager.current_params[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ERROR_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> should_error <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> word:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成真实错误</span>
                erroneous_word =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> error_library.generate_realistic_error(word, context)
                
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> erroneous_word:
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ❌ 输入错误: '{word}' -&gt; '{erroneous_word}'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                    
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输入错误版本</span>
                    pyautogui.write(erroneous_word, interval=random.uniform(0.1, 0.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
                    
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 安排错误检测（不会立即发现）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    cognitive_model.schedule_error_detection({
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">typo</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">original</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: erroneous_word,
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">corrected</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: word,
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">position</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: (line_num, word_index)
                    })
                    
                    line_errors </span>+= 1
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span>
            
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 正常输入</span>
            char_delay =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> random.uniform(
                </span>0.1 /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> personality.effective_speed,
                </span>0.5 /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> personality.effective_speed
            )
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟思考（在特定字符后）</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> word <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> any(c <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> word <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> c <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]):
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> random.random() &lt; param_manager.current_params[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">THINKING_PROBABILITY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]:
                    think_time </span>= random.uniform(0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, personality.thinking_time)
                    time.sleep(think_time)
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  🤔 思考中 ({think_time:.1f}s)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            
            pyautogui.write(word, interval</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">char_delay)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 记录本行错误数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        recent_error_count.append(line_errors)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 7. 行后行为</span>
        line_end_time =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time.time()
        line_duration </span>= line_end_time -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> line_start_time
        line_timings.append(line_duration)
        recent_speed_samples.append(len(line) </span>/ line_duration <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> line_duration &gt; 0 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保持最近10个样本</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> len(recent_speed_samples) &gt; 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            recent_speed_samples.pop(0)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> len(recent_error_count) &gt; 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            recent_error_count.pop(0)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 行间延迟（基于上下文和疲劳）</span>
        base_line_delay = random.uniform(0.5, 2.0) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> personality.effective_speed
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> context == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">complex</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            base_line_delay </span>*= 1.5
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> context == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">simple</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            base_line_delay </span>*= 0.7
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 疲劳增加延迟</span>
        base_line_delay *= (1 + personality.fatigue_level * 0.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  ⏱️  本行耗时: {line_duration:.1f}s | 延迟: {base_line_delay:.1f}s</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        pyautogui.press(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">enter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        time.sleep(base_line_delay)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 完成统计</span>
    total_time = time.time() -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> start_time
    avg_chars_per_second </span>= sum(len(line) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> line <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> lines) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> total_time
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 70<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🎉 模拟完成！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 70<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n📈 性能统计:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  总时间: {total_time/60:.1f}分钟</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  总行数: {total_lines}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  总错误: {total_errors}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  平均速度: {avg_chars_per_second:.1f} 字符/秒</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  平均每行: {total_time/total_lines:.1f}秒</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  疲劳程度: {personality.fatigue_level:.2f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  学习曲线: {personality.learning_curve:.2f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n🎭 模拟配置:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  程序员类型: {programmer_type.value}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  代码语言: {context_engine.code_language}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  最终情绪: {param_manager.mood_state}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n💾 数据已保存到: simulation_report.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存报告</span>
    report =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">timestamp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: datetime.now().isoformat(),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">programmer_type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: programmer_type.value,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code_language</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: context_engine.code_language,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total_lines</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: total_lines,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total_time_seconds</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: total_time,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total_errors</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: total_errors,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">avg_speed_chars_per_sec</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: avg_chars_per_second,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fatigue_level</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: personality.fatigue_level,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">learning_curve</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: personality.learning_curve,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">final_mood</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: param_manager.mood_state,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">line_timings</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: line_timings,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">param_history</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: param_manager.param_history
    }
    
    with open(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">simulation_report.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent</span>=2, ensure_ascii=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        main()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> KeyboardInterrupt:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n\n⚠️  模拟被用户中断</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n❌ 模拟错误: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> traceback
        traceback.print_exc()</span></pre>
